stories.title: Export-banned Nvidia chips are behind China’s most powerful AI models — uh oh, Jensen!
stories.explanation: New research indicates that advanced AI models from China were trained on Nvidia chips banned from export to the country. This highlights a significant challenge for Nvidia and U.S. export controls aimed at protecting leadership in AI capabilities.

stories.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
stories.explanation: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO following an affair with a Megaspeed executive, Alice Huang, who is alleged to be a Chinese spy. This scandal has raised national security concerns regarding the illegal sharing of Nvidia chips with China, which is under federal investigation.

stories.title: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation
stories.explanation: AI agent startup LangChain raised $300 million in Series C funding at a $3 billion valuation, led by CapitalG. The company's agent management tool, LangSmith, now serves 7,000 customers, focusing on providing model and platform-agnostic solutions for AI agent creation and management.

stories.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen
stories.explanation: Google introduced Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast, cost-efficient model designed for reliable agentic workflows and everyday tasks, making cutting-edge intelligence available across Google AI Studio, API, and other services.

stories.title: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet
stories.explanation: OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Wallet, a secure payment method for agents in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and dots, enabling purchases with user approval and existing card protections without exposing card details.

stories.title: ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI’s Dots agents make purchases for you
stories.explanation: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet, allowing its Dots AI agents to make purchases using linked credit or debit cards for ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the US. Users maintain control by reviewing and approving each transaction with a security check.

stories.title: llama.cpp v1.0.0 : A stronger foundation for the local AI ecosystem
stories.explanation: ggml-org released llama.cpp v1.0.0, providing a stable API for running multi-modal LLMs across various hardware through quantization and optimized backends, making AI inference more accessible.

stories.title: Google’s new Gemini model is better at understanding complicated questions
stories.explanation: Google launched its new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model, which is designed to provide more helpful answers to complex questions. This is a significant upgrade to Google's AI capabilities, available across various products.

stories.title: Building strong safety evaluations
stories.explanation: Anthropic released recommendations for designing, running, and reporting safety evaluations for AI models, based on their experiences, to inform decisions about model deployment and safeguards.

stories.title: ElevenLabs’ new app combines meeting note-taking and dictation for teams
stories.explanation: ElevenLabs launched ElevenAI, an experimental app combining meeting note-taking, dictation, and agent integration for teams and enterprises. The app allows users to take notes across meetings, query data, and integrate ElevenAgent for follow-up actions like drafting emails.
